description: GNU make utility to maintain groups of programs.

option.name: --always-make
tip: Unconditionally make all targets.

option.name: --assume-new
tip: Consider FILE to be infinitely new.

option.name: --assume-old
tip: Consider FILE to be very old and do not remake it.

option.name: --check-symlink-times
tip: Use the latest mtime between symlinks and target.

option.name: --debug
tip: Print various types of debugging information.
FLAGS can be all, basic, verbose, implicit, jobs, makefile, print, why or none.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --directory
tip: Change to DIRECTORY before doing anything.

option.name: --environment-overrides
tip: Environment variables override makefiles.

option.name: --eval
tip: Evaluate STRING as a makefile statement.

option.name: --help
tip: Print this message and exit.

option.name: --ignore-errors
tip: Ignore errors from recipes.

option.name: --include-dir
tip: Search DIRECTORY for included makefiles.

option.name: --jobs
tip: Allow N jobs at once; infinite jobs with no argument.
The value must be attached with = for the long form.

option.name: --jobserver-style
tip: Select the style of jobserver to use.
Possible values: fifo, pipe, sem.
sem is Windows only.

option.name: --just-print
tip: Do not actually run any recipe; just print them.

option.name: --keep-going
tip: Keep going when some targets cannot be made.

option.name: --load-average
tip: Do not start multiple jobs unless load is below N.
The value must be attached with = for the long forms.

option.name: --makefile
tip: Read FILE as a makefile.

option.name: --no-builtin-rules
tip: Disable the built-in implicit rules.

option.name: --no-builtin-variables
tip: Disable the built-in variable settings.

option.name: --no-keep-going
tip: Turn off --keep-going.

option.name: --no-print-directory
tip: Turn off --print-directory, even if it was turned on implicitly.

option.name: --no-silent
tip: Echo recipes (disable --silent mode).

option.name: --output-sync
tip: Synchronize output of parallel jobs by TYPE.
TYPE can be none, line, target or recurse.
The value must be attached with = for the long form.

option.name: --print-data-base
tip: Print make's internal database.

option.name: --print-directory
tip: Print the current directory.

option.name: --question
tip: Run no recipe; exit status says if up to date.

option.name: --shuffle
tip: Shuffle prerequisites and goals.
MODE can be none, random, reverse or an integer seed.
The value must be attached with =.

option.name: --silent
tip: Do not echo recipes.

option.name: --touch
tip: Touch targets instead of remaking them.

option.name: --trace
tip: Print tracing information.

option.name: --version
tip: Print the version number of make and exit.

option.name: --warn-undefined-variables
tip: Warn when an undefined variable is referenced.

option.name: -b
tip: Ignored for compatibility.

option.name: -d
tip: Print lots of debugging information.

option.name: -m
tip: Ignored for compatibility.
